hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in *.rb|*.rake|*.ru|*/Rakefile) o=$(bundle exec rubocop --server --force-exclusion --no-color --format simple "$f" 2>/dev/null); [ $? -ne 0 ] && { printf 'RuboCop offenses in %s, please fix them (the CI gate blocks otherwise):\n%s\n' "$f" "$o" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; exit 0
